values.en: For a regular smooth parametrized surface $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ and $q\in\Omega$, the **affine tangent plane** at $q$ is the translate of the linear tangent plane by the surface point $X(q)$: $X(q)+T_{q}X=\{X(q)+w\mid w\in T_{q}X\}$. The translation is essential: $T_{q}X$ is a linear subspace through the origin, whereas the affine tangent plane is the plane through $X(q)$ tangent to the surface. Here $q=(u,v)$ is the parameter point and $X(q)\in\mathbb{R}^{3}$ is the surface point.
values.zh-CN: 对正则光滑参数曲面 $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 与 $q\in\Omega$，$q$ 处的**仿射切平面**是线性切平面经曲面点 $X(q)$ 平移所得：$X(q)+T_{q}X=\{X(q)+w\mid w\in T_{q}X\}$。平移不可省略：$T_{q}X$ 是过原点的线性子空间，仿射切平面才是过 $X(q)$ 且与曲面相切的平面。这里 $q=(u,v)$ 是参数点，$X(q)\in\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 是曲面点。
